meta.source: First-party inner-page audit: one internal deep link per site (discovered from homepage), plain HTTP vs headless Chromium
meta.method: Deep link chosen heuristically from homepage nav (pricing/features/product/about style paths). Raw = plain HTTP, rendered = Chromium after settle. Coverage = raw words / rendered words, capped at 100. Sites with no discoverable deep link or non-200 raw responses are null. The audit covered 1,025 measured sites of the extended study; the final ~70 of the second batch were not reached (run stopped for time), so some measured sites have no inner-page row.
